idea-plugin.name: Binding Result Position Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Warning icon on a Spring MVC controller method parameter annotated @Valid/@Validated whose matching BindingResult/Errors parameter exists somewhere in the method signature, but isn't the parameter immediately following it -- Spring's own ErrorsMethodArgumentResolver javadoc is explicit: "An Errors method argument is expected to appear immediately after the model attribute in the method signature." When another parameter is inserted between them, Spring can't resolve the binding result for that attribute at all.

100% static text/PSI analysis -- matches annotation/ type names by simple text, so it works whether the real Spring jar is on the classpath or not. Java and Kotlin. Confirmed gap: JetBrains' own bundled Spring MVC plugin only offers autocompletion for BindingResult parameters (BindingResultParameterProvider), it does not validate correct positioning -- confirmed by extracting and reading the plugin's own plugin.xml directly.

Stated honestly: v0.1 only flags the case where a BindingResult/Errors parameter DOES exist somewhere but isn't immediately next -- a @Valid parameter with no BindingResult/Errors at all is a legitimate, common pattern and is never flagged.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no network calls.
